svg.title: Two speakers use the past to persuade
svg.desc: Joseph in 1974 : Roman decline is an analogy for his prediction of dependency. Obama in 2009 : Earlier reforms lend authority to a contested health proposal. Historical question : What do these comparisons establish about the present decision?

g.text: Two speakers use the past to persuade
Roman decline is an analogy for his prediction of dependency.
Earlier reforms lend authority to a contested health proposal.
What do these comparisons establish about the present decision?
